race.comment: LOPE DE LUNA (3) backed up the good second two back, with a sharp Maiden win over 1400m at Scone from the inside draw. Looks ready for this contest and extra trip. Can make it two straight despite drawing out. MIDNIGHT IN MINORI (8) racing in career best form and looks ready for the mile. Savaged the line in a fast run contest when second over 1300m at Dubbo. Maps well again and shapes as the main danger. ITALIAN MADE (2) showed good gate speed on debut from the wide draw with a dominant victory over 1300m at Dubbo nine days ago. Has the upside to overcome the awkward gate. OMINOUS (9) blinkers come off and the visors go on after the two good runs for the new yard. Chased hard with the 59kg when a sound second over 1600m at Tamworth. Must be respected from the low draw.
